decisions.decision: Frontend foundation uses a custom React shell rather than a heavy admin/dashboard template.
decisions.rationale: The product is a trading workstation, not a CRUD admin panel. Flexibility later is more important than template speed now.

decisions.decision: Phase 1 defaults to mock-safe runtime with live trading forced off unless explicitly enabled later.
decisions.rationale: Paper-first and local-safe behavior are mandatory project constraints.

decisions.decision: Compose remains a two-service baseline: backend and frontend only.
decisions.rationale: Phase 1 is intentionally lightweight and local-first.

next_action: On the new machine, run the Docker-based human verification for Phase 1 first. Do not start Phase 2 until 01-HUMAN-UAT.md is resolved.
